integrity: All proofs and claims concern the precisely defined model. Numerical checks are supplementary, not proofs. No claim of independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Power-law diagonal Hilbert--Schmidt operators, iid one-coordinate isotropic sketches and squared Hilbert--Schmidt range-projection error only; the minimizing closed-simplex law is not itself isotropic on the whole space, but the infimum is approximated by full-support isotropic laws. A generic prior weighted-coverage result may overlap; independent historical-priority assessment is unperformed.
title: Optimal independent coordinate sketches: exact finite-support design and the \(\rho^\rho\) power-law loss
